title: VibeGraph quality layer: stack profile
description: Derived archetype detection: the selector that makes every quality and flow rule archetype-relative. Every fact carries an ordinal confidence tied to the evidence ladder stack_attribution.ts already uses, and at least one supporting node, because a fact with no node behind it is an assertion. Facts the IR cannot derive appear under `unknowns` with a reason; they are never defaulted. Regimes are tags derived from facts and must name the facts that support them. Facts are held at project level and per thread, because a regime is a property of a thread (a route handler and a training loop can share a repository). Derived only: provenance is Derived, never stated. Run 3 writes the deriver; this pins its output.

project.description: The analysed project root as the server knows it.

threads.description: Per-thread profile keyed by entryPointId. A thread's facts override the project's for predicate evaluation; its regimes are its own.

FactName.description: The closed catalogue of derivable facts. Each names the envelope surface it is read from. languages: files[].language. entryKinds: entryPoints[].kind. frameworks: entryPoints[].framework (evidence-based only). rolesPresent: stack.byFile / byThread. rolesCalled: stack.byThreadCalled (a boundary reaches the tool). funnels: stack.tools[].wraps. subsystems: system.subsystems[].kind. effectfulLoops: thread contract roundTrips non-empty. testsPresent: an entry of kind test or a tool with role test. crossings: crossings.ts joins for the thread. unattributedBoundaries: contract boundaries.unattributed non-zero.

Confidence.description: Ordinal, not numeric, keyed to the attribution ladder. exact: the linker or index keyed it (qualified, call-site, binding, an entry-point record, a file's language). attributed: a rule attributed it (global, runtime, local-binding, handler-param). file-level: only the file-level fact (funnel-file, present-not-called).

supportingNodes.description: Never empty. The nodes (file:node) the fact was read from.

readFrom.description: The envelope surface, e.g. entryPoints[].kind, stack.byThreadCalled.

RegimeId.description: Tags a thread or project can carry. Derived by rules over facts in Run 3; the schema only requires that each tag names its supporting facts. http-service: an entry of kind route. cli-tool: kind cli. library: only public_api entries. ml-model: kind model or role tensor called. ops-script: bash with subprocess or remote subsystems. test-suite: kind test. polyglot: more than one language reached. unknown: no rule fired, with a reason.

derivedFrom.description: The facts that fired the tag. Never empty.

UnknownFactName.description: Facts the source cannot yield. hotPaths: which loops iterate a lot (only a trace says). dataVolume, latencyBudget, deploymentTarget, consumers: not in the code; state them as constraints.
